record.question: Which country has passed a law banning the use of social media by minors under the age of 16?
record.explanation: Answer C: Australia. Australia enacted a law restricting under-16s’ access to specified social-media platforms in 2024; phased commencement is later. Reference: https://www.legislation.gov.au/C2024A00127/latest/text. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical context: LDC Law & Judicial Paper-I, February 2026 examination; current officeholder/current affairs claims interpreted as of paper date.. Officeholders, survey results and forecasts refer to that original paper, not necessarily the present. No matching examiner key is asserted.
